docs.cv:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher and meat counter professional with experience across market and high-street settings since 2015. Skilled in carcass breakdown, portioning, customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, cold-chain temperature records, and food hygiene routines.

KEY SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) | Boning and trimming | Fresh sausage production | Meat portioning | Customer advice on cuts and cooking | FIFO stock rotation | Cold-chain temperature checks and records | Food hygiene and cleaning routines | Knife sharpening | Mincer and bandsaw operation | Paper-wrapping counter orders | Customer service | Cash handling

EXPERIENCE
Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides weekly; bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the counter.
- Make four fresh sausage varieties to the shop's recipes, producing about 40 kg weekly in the busy season.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.
- Rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing the oldest stock at the front.
- Serve about 120 customers on Saturdays, advising on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close.
- Wrote the stall's one-page closing and cleaning checklist after a hygiene inspection remark; it remains posted inside the cold-room door.

SELECTED PROJECTS & ACHIEVEMENTS
- Shop sausage range (2020–Present): Developed the shop's lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef / 30% lamb following customer feedback. The shop's ćevapi won 2nd place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair (Sajam mesnih proizvoda), 2023.
- Wedding and party catering (2022–2025): Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at three weddings and about 10 family parties a year; ordered, butchered, seasoned and delivered the meat on the event morning. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in Samobor, 2024.
- Dry-aged beef trial (2024): Ran a six-week trial dry-ageing beef ribs for 21 and 28 days in a rented cabinet, keeping weight-loss and temperature records. The shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order, about 15 kg a month.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational certificate: Butcher (3-year programme), Food Trades School Zagreb, 2015
HACCP basic food hygiene certificate, 2021 (renewed 2024)

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Preparing for the master butcher exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027; not yet passed.

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) | English (good) | German (basic)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart's Zagreb-Jarun store. Since 2015, I have worked in meat counters, and since 2019 I have combined carcass breakdown and portioning with customer service, stock rotation and temperature records.

At Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, prepare fresh sausages, and advise about 120 Saturday customers on cuts and cooking times. I rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO and record cold-room and display-counter temperatures twice daily. I hold a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024, and have trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines. The shop's ćevapi, whose mix I adjusted following customer feedback, won 2nd place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.

FreshCart's staffed meat counters and “Ask the counter” promise make product knowledge and honest customer advice central to the role. I would bring hands-on butchery, careful hygiene routines and experience serving busy counter customers. I am also preparing for the master butcher exam, planned for spring 2027.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my experience and how I could contribute to the Jarun store.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić
